create_NDVarArray: create an NDVarArray for n-dimensional grids of variables with a given shape and number of states
build_variable_hashes: build a variable hash array for each position in an n-dimensional variable grid
flatten_data: flatten structured data arrays into a flat JAX array for internal use in probabilistic inference
unflatten_data: unflatten a 1D data array back into structured per-variable or per-state data
retrieve_variables: retrieve variables by index or slice from an NDVarArray returning variable hash and state count tuples
